finish.summary: Built a tidy 3-cell sewing-supplies organizer: a full-depth 3-compartment bin, a full-depth 2-compartment bin, and a shallow half-depth 3-compartment bin for small notions, all capped and joint-bolted. Dressed with a tape measure, tweezers, brush and small-item heaps to show use; check_build passes with meshClash clear.

lines.label: M6 x 25 socket head screw, ISO 4762

notes: Tighten every M6 to 2 N.m: HAND TOOLS ONLY, never a cordless driver. These bolts clamp printed PETG, not metal: at the bolt's own 10.4 N.m rating the head crushes the plastic under it and the joint fails silently, looking tight while holding nothing. Snug, then a nudge. Re-check the bolts after the first few weeks: PETG relaxes under load and the clamp will have eased.

events.text: Keeping your sewing supplies tidy — I'll build a compartmented hex organizer and stock it with visible sewing tools.
